title: Prep these 3 staples so cooking is so much easier all week
summary: The first thing I do after a Korean grocery haul? Prep these 3 staples so cooking is so much easier all week.
caption: The first thing I do after a Korean grocery haul? Prep these 3 staples so cooking is so much easier all week. 👏🇰🇷 ✨ Garlic & Ginger I blend them in a food processor, flatten them in a reusable zip-top bag, and freeze them. For the garlic, I use a chopstick to make little squares so I can break off exactly what I need. ✨ Green Onions I separate the light green and dark green parts since I use them in different dishes. I also save some of the white ends to regrow in a jar of water, and keep the rooted white parts for soups. No more wilted green onions hiding in the back of the fridge or peeling garlic every time I cook. Everything is prepped and ready for busy weeknight meals! Do you prep your Korean staples too, or is there another ingredient you always keep ready? ⬇️  #easyrecipe #mealprepideas #foodprep #korean #foodtiktok
